pr_title: plan: support caching prepare plan for query on hash partition tables
pr_body:
<!--
Thank you for contributing to TiDB! Please read TiDB's [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/pingcap/community/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document **BEFORE** filing this PR.
-->

### What problem does this PR solve? <!--add issue link with summary if exists-->
fix #11945
Prepare plan cache will cache physical table id for partition. Partition id changing as query conditions change. So, the physical table id may also change. Query on partition table will not return correct result if prepare plan cache is on.

### What is changed and how it works?
For hash partition, recalculate physical table id by calculate partition expression.

 - None

Side effects

 - Possible performance regression

Related changes

Release note

issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

1. What did you do?
Using hash partition create TPC-C test table, turning on prepare plan cache and run test. 
```
bmsql_district | CREATE TABLE `bmsql_district` (
  `d_w_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `d_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `d_ytd` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `d_tax` decimal(4,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `d_next_o_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `d_name` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `d_street_1` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `d_street_2` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `d_city` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `d_state` char(2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `d_zip` char(9) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`d_w_id`,`d_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
PARTITION BY HASH( `d_w_id` + `d_id` )
PARTITIONS 32 |
```

review_comments: What happens in the else branch, when the condition doesn't meet?
Wrong result would be returned for range partitioned table as well?
If it is not a single point plan, it will be a full table scan.
For range partitioned table, shall the partition ID of the cached plan be updated as well?
extract a common function to avoid repeated code?
Table partition does not support `BatchPointGet` yet.
